systemSummary.name: Restate Distributed Durable Execution Runtime
systemSummary.description: High-throughput, event-driven runtime providing resilient virtual actors, durable workflows, and transactional state journals communicating over HTTP/2 and gRPC.

executionEngine.description: Virtual actor state machine executing journal replaying and suspension loops.

protocolLayer.description: Binary streaming protocol between Restate engine and user service SDKs.

storageLayer.description: Embedded RocksDB partition database with durable LSN tracking and outbox journals.

consensusLayer.description: Bifrost consensus protocol managing replicated loglets across cluster nodes.

durableExecutionModel.virtualActorJournaling: Each virtual object invocation executes as an event-sourced stream. Non-deterministic operations (calls, sleeps, side-effects) append entries to the partition journal.
durableExecutionModel.serviceProtocolStreaming: User services stream journal entries over HTTP/2. When an uncompleted promise/awakeable is encountered, the connection suspends without holding server threads.
durableExecutionModel.singleActorConcurrency: Virtual objects enforce strict single-writer concurrency per object ID via VQueues, preventing concurrent mutating state corruption.
durableExecutionModel.durableTimers: Timers and durable sleeps are registered in TimerQueue and awaken suspended invocations when deadlines elapse.
durableExecutionModel.bifrostReplication: Log entries are replicated via Bifrost consensus before acknowledgments are returned to callers.
